description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Scourge of Valkas.
The five Scourge of Valkas tokens enter the battlefield, triggering each Scourge of Valkas five times.
Resolve all Scourge of Valkas triggers, dealing at least 180 damage divided among a maximum of 30 targets.
